blind.conclusion_restated: 独立推导成立：固定 n >= 2K，令唯一的 predictor 为与 instance 无关的 \tilde f(S)=|S|，并对每个 |A|=K 定义 modular 的 f_A(S)=|S \cap A| + w|S \setminus A|，w=K/(n-K)。因为算法不能 query f 且整个 family 共用一个 \tilde f，任何 deterministic algorithm（即便有无限制的 arbitrary query access，可读完 \tilde f 的整张值表）的 transcript 与 A 无关，输出是一个固定集合 T，|T| <= K；n >= 2K 保证可在 N\T 中取 |A|=K 与 T 不交，于是 f_A(T)=w|T| <= wK = (K/(n-K)) f_A(O*)，且 f_A(O*)=f_A(A)=K。该 instance 的误差恰为 (\eta_u,\eta_o)=(1,(n-K)/K)，即 \eta=(n-K)/K=1/ratio，有限但随 n 无界，这正是"不假设 \eta 上界"这一前提被用到的地方；令 n -> \infty 即得不存在与 n 无关的常数 worst-case ratio。把 w 换成任意 \epsilon>0 可把比值压到 \epsilon，代价是 \eta=1/\epsilon。对 randomized algorithm，取 A 均匀随机、\epsilon=K^2/(n(n-K))，由恒等式 K/n + K^2/(n(n-K)) = K/(n-K) 得 E[f(T)] <= (K/(n-K)) f(O*)（存在一个固定 pair 达到该期望界），代价是 \eta 升到 n(n-K)/K^2；randomized 在该 family 上的真实量级是 \Theta(K/n)，与 K/(n-K) 相差不超过 2 倍。全部结论在 K<=3、2K<=n<=8 上用 Fraction 精确穷举确认，核心恒等式用 sympy 确认。
quantifiers: 预先固定整数 K >= 1 与整数 n，满足 n >= 2K（结合 assumptions.md 的 1 <= K <= n）；ground set N，|N| = n
对每一个 deterministic algorithm A（无内部随机性；query 序列与输出是已收到 oracle 回答的确定函数）
arbitrary query access 取最强解释：对 \tilde f 可做任意多次（含 2^n 次，读遍整张值表）、任意自适应、不限于 value query 的 query；算法免费知道 n、K 与 instance family 的描述；但不能 query f
输出 T 必须满足 cardinality budget：|T| <= K（statement 原文未写，按 assumptions.md 的 budget 补上，属于额外加入的读法）

存在 pair (f, \tilde f)：f: 2^N -> R_{>=0} monotone submodular 且 f(空集)=0；\tilde f: 2^N -> R 且 \tilde f(空集)=0；满足 Definition 1（convention B）的 marginal-gain error 条件，\eta_u,\eta_o > 0，\eta = \eta_u \eta_o >= 1 有限但不受任何预先给定上界约束
结论：f(T) <= (K/(n-K)) f(O*)，O* 为 optimal K-set，f(O*) = K > 0（故 assumptions.md 中 f(O*)=0 的平凡旁路不被触发）
量词次序为 for all A, for all (n,K) with n >= 2K, there exists (f,\tilde f)：instance 在算法之后选取，adversary 可先算出 T 再挑 A
tie breaking：对一般 deterministic algorithm 不涉及；若特化为 predictive greedy，则需要 adversarial tie breaking（所有 \tilde d_e 并列为 1），此时 \eta^{sel} = (n-K)/K
randomized 情形：结论从逐点 worst-case 变为对算法内部随机性的期望，且存在一个固定 pair 使 E_R[f(T)] <= (K/(n-K)) f(O*)
key_steps: Step 1: f_A(S)=|S∩A|+w|S\A|（w=K/(n-K) ∈ (0,1]）是 nonnegative modular，f(空集)=0，全部边际增益 = w_e > 0 故 monotone，diminishing returns 取等号故 submodular [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]
Step 2: \tilde f(S)=|S| 满足 \tilde f(空集)=0；它本身也是 monotone modular，故即便额外要求 predictor 为 monotone submodular 构造仍成立
Step 3: 所有 d_e(S)=w_e>0 且 \tilde d_e(S)=1>0，Definition 1 的 support 条件（d=0 当且仅当 \tilde d=0）成立
Step 4: Definition 1 化为 w_e <= \eta_u 且 1 <= \eta_o w_e，最小取法 (\eta_u,\eta_o)=(1,(n-K)/K)，故 \eta=(n-K)/K；convention B 的 rescale 不改变 \eta [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]
Step 5: f_A modular 且 w <= 1，故 O* = A，F^OPT = f_A(A) = K > 0 [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]
Step 6: family 共用一个 \tilde f 且算法不能 query f，deterministic 归纳给出 transcript 与 A 无关 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 7: 因此输出是一个与 A 无关的固定集合 T，|T| <= K（后续步骤对一切这样的 T 取全称，故不依赖 Step 6-7 的模型形式化细节）
Step 8: |N\T| >= n-K >= K，存在 |A|=K 与 T 不交（n >= 2K 在全证明中唯一被用到的地方）[VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]
Step 9: 该 A 下 f_A(T) = w|T| <= wK = K^2/(n-K)
Step 10: 结合 f_A(O*)=K 得 f_A(T) <= (K/(n-K)) f_A(O*)，误差 \eta=(n-K)/K [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE for K<=3, 2K<=n<=8；穷举的 max_T min_A 比值恰等于界，等号可取]
Step 11: 固定 K 取 n > K + K/alpha 得 K/(n-K) < alpha，故不存在与 n 无关的常数 worst-case ratio
Step 11': 特化为 predictive greedy 时所有 \tilde d 并列，adversarial tie breaking 把 K 步全放在 N\A，\eta^{sel} = 1/w = (n-K)/K [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
推广: 把 w 换成任意 \epsilon ∈ (0,1] 得 ratio <= \epsilon 且 \eta = 1/\epsilon；命题的 K/(n-K) 是使 A 外总质量等于 f(O*) 的平衡取法，对应该 family 中最小的 \eta，满足 ratio = 1/\eta
randomized: T 与均匀随机的 A 独立，取 \epsilon=K^2/(n(n-K))，E[f(T)]/K <= K/n + \epsilon = K/(n-K)（恒等式 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]），平均值论证给出存在固定 pair，\eta = n(n-K)/K^2 [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]
n < 2K: 任意 |T|=K 与 |A|=K 必有 |T∩A| >= 2K-n，比值 >= (2K-n)/K > 0，构造失效，说明 n >= 2K 是本路线的真实需求 [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]
gaps: Step 6-7（deterministic + arbitrary query access 导致 transcript 与 A 无关）是关于计算模型的论证，无 oracle 可直接检验，标 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]；缓解措施是后续步骤与全部脚本检查对一切 |T| <= K 取全称
额外加入的假设：|T| <= K。statement 原文只写 the output T，未写可行性；按 assumptions.md 的 cardinality budget 补上。若允许 |T| > K，命题字面不成立（取 T=N）
额外加入的解释：arbitrary query access 取为无限制（可读完整张值表）；这只使结论更强，若原意是 poly-query 也被覆盖
脚本穷举范围仅 K <= 3、2K <= n <= 8（randomized 部分同）；一般 (n,K) 的 Step 4/9/10 与第 6 节不等式链为手写单行代数，标 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 11' 的 \eta^{sel} = (n-K)/K 为手算，未写独立脚本，标 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]

Exact Fractions.

C.name: C2 Definition 1 band; smallest admissible factors eta_u=1, eta_o=1/delta, both attained
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] 896560 (S,e) pairs scanned; max d/dtilde = 1 and max dtilde/d = 1/delta in every instance, product = eta = 1/delta, and d=0 iff dtilde=0 everywhere. Both ends attained (eta_u by an element of O, eta_o by an element outside O).

C.name: C3 OPT = f(O) = K
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] 160 instances; full subset enumeration over |S|<=K and the count-lattice enumeration give the same value K, with O an argmax (delta<=1 keeps the K largest modular weights on O).

C.name: C4/C5 predictive greedy (adversarial ties) and exhaustive argmax of ftilde over K-sets (adversarial ties)
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] 320 algorithm runs. All predicted gains equal 1 and all K-sets tie (e.g. K=3,n=9: 20 tied K-sets; greedy uses 27 queries, exhaustive argmax 84), so the adversary always lands on an output disjoint from O and f(T) = delta|T| <= delta*OPT holds in every run.

C.name: C6 arbitrary fixed output T with |T| <= K
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] 18240 fixed outputs across all instances, each with its own disjoint O rebuilt as the appendices prescribe; f(T) <= delta*OPT in all, with equality in 11450 of them (exactly the |T|=K cases).

C.name: C7 existence of a disjoint K-set O for every output when n >= 2K
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] 3648 outputs checked over the whole grid; n - |T| >= K always, so O exists.

C.name: C8 n = 2K-1 exhibit (where the argument fails)
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] 12 cases (K=1..4, delta in {1/2,1/5,1/50}), unreachable in all 12. With |T|=K only K-1 elements remain, so every K-set O meets T in at least 2K-n = 1 element and the best possible ratio is (1 + delta(K-1))/K > delta for delta<1. Numbers at delta=1/2: K=2,n=3 -> 3/4; K=3,n=5 -> 2/3; K=4,n=7 -> 5/8; K=1,n=1 -> 1. So n >= 2K is load-bearing.

C.name: C9 (extra) randomized averaging step of app:necessity with gamma
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] exact sum over all C(n,K) choices of a uniform random O, 2290 terms total: E_O[f_O(T)]/OPT <= K/(n-K) in every grid cell, matching K/n + gamma = K/(n-K).

C.name: C10 running example K = 3, eta = 3/2
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] f(O)=3, f(T)=2, ratio 2/3 = 1/eta, eta_u=1, eta_o=3/2 both attained. Recorded scope: with eta fixed at 3/2 (delta=2/3) the statement constant K/(n-K) is met exactly for 2K <= n <= K + K*eta = 7 (n=6: 1, n=7: 3/4; n=8: 3/5 < 2/3, n=12: 1/3 < 2/3). K = 3, delta = 1/eta = 2/3, O = {0,1,2}, T = {3,4,5}: f(O) = 3 = OPT, f(T) = 3 * 2/3 = 2, ratio 2/3 = 1/eta, with eta_u = 1 and eta_o = 3/2 both attained.

oracle.notes:
Both route-one constructions are the same one-parameter modular family f_delta(S) = |S cap O| + delta|S \ O| with ftilde(S) = |S|; construction A (appendix_model_proofs.tex) takes delta = K/(n-K), construction B (app:necessity in appendix_proofs.tex) takes gamma = K^2/(n(n-K)). C0 shows delta - gamma = K/n > 0 exactly, so the gamma instance is strictly stronger than the statement constant by the factor K/n, and C9 shows why gamma is chosen: K/n + gamma = K/(n-K) is exactly what the uniform-random-O averaging needs. This corroborates the recommendation already in results/V11/notes.md to keep the delta version in the paper (it matches the statement constant directly and generalizes to any delta in (0,1]) and to drop the gamma version when app:model is wired, with the caveat that the randomized remark in app:necessity relies on gamma.

Every decision uses fractions.Fraction (or sympy for C0); floats appear only in printed text. Seeds fixed: 20260918 (D loop), 11 (full-subset resubsampling). In criterion D each trial is decided on the count lattice (complete for this f, since f depends on S only through (|S cap O|, |S \ O|)), and 214 of the 2400 trials additionally got a full 2^n subset rescan that agreed on f, band, OPT and f(T) in every case; criterion C does the full subset scan for all 160 instances, so no item is [VERIFIED-LP floating point] and none had to be marked as such.

Scripts that would overwrite existing repo outputs (results/J2_core_oracles.py, P0/P1) were not rerun, since the task forbids modifying existing repo files; that decision and its reason are recorded in the reruns field of nobound.json. No existing repo file was touched; the four deliverables are new files in the previously empty results/V11/oracle/. No git command was run.

Two scope items worth carrying to the V11 matrix: (1) the quantifier over all deterministic algorithms is not oracle-coverable (GAP row above); (2) the K=3, eta=3/2 running example only meets the statement constant for n <= 7, so if that example is used in the text next to prop:necessity the n range needs to be stated, or the example restated at the statement's own eta = (n-K)/K.

oracle.notes:
All 21 criterion-C checks PASS, exit code 0, zero violations in 6597 random draws. No existing repo file was modified and git was never run. Exact arithmetic (Fraction / sympy) decides every check; floats appear only in printouts. Seeds fixed: (i) 20260918, (ii) 20260919, (iii) 20260920.

Counts: monotone checks 182476, submodularity checks 401245 (local-exchange form, equivalent for set functions), band (S,e) pair checks 183231, subsets scanned in C4 57840.

Design points worth relaying. (1) eta_u and eta_o are always recomputed as the ACTUAL smallest admissible factors from the instance (max d/dtilde and max dtilde/d), never taken from the generator, so (iii) is tested at its tightest. (2) Legal surrogates come from four generators with rejection sampling on legality: scaled (ftilde = c0 f), plus_modular (f plus theta times a modular function whose weights are bounded by f's minimum gains), elementwise (per-element factors on a modular f), and jitter (multiplicative per-set perturbation, accept/reject); 404 draws were rejected and redrawn. (3) eta = eta_u eta_o >= 1 is checked on every trial, not assumed. (4) For (ii), eta^sel = 1 is verified in the strong form "argmax set of dtilde equals argmax set of d at every state", which covers adversarial tie-breaking rather than one trajectory.

Two extras beyond the brief, both PASS and both cheap: C1b re-verifies the OLD appendix_proofs.tex app:valueacc part-(i) instance (a different two-element construction from the convention-B one, so route one has two independent witnesses for (i)), and C7a/C7b pin down why the old statement needed the eta_o < 2 proviso and that the convention-B level never leaves (0,1).

One GAP and one SKIPPED item, both recorded in the report section 6 rather than silently dropped: the closing clause of (i) about L_K(eta) bounds rests on the L_K(infinity) = 0 convention and is not oracle-decidable; and the "96 legal surrogates" check cited in HANDOFF_ADDENDUM section B item 10 has no script in the repo, so it is not cited as evidence and this oracle supersedes it.

Content observation for the ledger: the equality counts (34472 lower-end and 31725 upper-end ties out of 57840 subsets) say the level (eta-1)/(eta+1) is attained, not merely sufficient, on this family. That supports the statement's phrasing "value-accurate at level (eta-1)/(eta+1)" being the right constant rather than a convenient one.

A_diffs: D1 标题限定: 台账按 addendum §B 第5条改成 "Value accuracy is neither sufficient nor necessary for predictive greedy"; 正文 results.tex 的 proposition 标题仍是无限定版 "…neither sufficient nor necessary"。
D2 (ii) 的 η 结论: 台账写 "Definition 1 以 η_u=1/(1+M)、η_o=1+M 成立, 全局 η=1"; 正文 (ii) 完全没有关于 η 的结论, 只给 η^sel=1。该结论在正文当前的 def:eta（η_u,η_o ≥ 1）下为假, 最小合法对是 (1,1+M) 给 η=1+M>1 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]。
D3 (ii) 末句: 正文多 "the full guarantee of Proposition~\ref{prop:guarantee} applies to the run"; 台账 (ii) 无此句。

D4 (iii) 的 value accuracy level: 正文 max{1−1/η_u, η_o−1}（依赖拆分）, 台账 (η−1)/(η+1)（只依赖乘积 η）。精确关系: 固定 η 对拆分求 min max{1−1/η_u, η_o−1} 恰等于 (η−1)/(η+1), 最小点 η_u=(η+1)/2, 达到它所需的缩放恰是 c=2η_u/(η+1) [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]。η=3/2 时正文 level 随拆分为 1/2、1/3、1, 台账 level 恒为 1/5。
D5 (iii) 的 η_o<2 前提: 正文有 "provided that this value is below 1 (that is, η_o<2)"; 台账明写"无 η_o<2 前提"。已核: 在 η_u ≥ 1 下 max{1−1/η_u, η_o−1}<1 当且仅当 η_o<2 [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]。
D6 (iii) 的存在量词 ∃c>0: 台账结论是 c f̃ value-accurate（c=2η_u/(η+1)）; 正文结论直接说 f̃ 本身 value-accurate, 无缩放。去掉 c 后台账的 level 结论为假, (ii) 的 f̃=(1+M)f 即反例。
D7 (iii) 对 f 的假设: 正文 "for a nonnegative f"; 台账 "只用 f 单调与 f(∅)=f̃(∅)=0, 不用 submodularity"。三处不一致: nonnegative vs monotone、归一化只在台账、"不用 submodularity" 只在台账。两份路线一证明用的都是 monotone, 正文的 nonnegative 无证明支持。
D8 (iii) 的 set-level band f(S)/η_u ≤ f̃(S) ≤ η_o f(S) ∀S: 台账写进陈述, 正文只留在附录证明里。

blind.conclusion_restated: 两个方向都独立推导出来了，结论与所给陈述一致。上界方向：对每个 deterministic algorithm 与每对 eta_u,eta_o>=1，取与实例无关的 predictor tilde f(A)=|A|，再把 h=min{K,n-K} 个权重 eta_u 的重元素藏在算法输出 T 之外（其余元素权重 1/eta_o），得到 modular f，其 error 两侧都取等（即恰好 (eta_u,eta_o)），且 f(T)/f(O*) <= K/(K+(eta-1)h) = C*_{n,K}(eta)，这正是 K<=n<=2K 时的 K/((2K-n)+(n-K)eta) 与 n>=2K 时的 1/eta。下界方向（非平凡的 exchange 论证）：设 S 在全部 K-subsets 上 maximize tilde f，令 r=f-tilde f（先把 band 归一化成 [d/eta, d]），则 r 单调且 r 的 marginal <= theta d，theta=1-1/eta；由 tilde f(S)>=tilde f(O*) 得 f(O*)-f(S) <= r(O*)-r(S) <= r(S∪O*)-r(S) <= theta[f(S∪O*)-f(S)]（主不等式 J），再由 submodular 展开 f(S∪O*)-f(S) <= sum_o d_o(S)、single-swap maximality 给出 d_o(S) <= eta*min_s d_s(S\s)、以及 sum_s d_s(S\s) <= f(S) 得 min_s d_s(S\s) <= f(S)/K，合并即得 f(S) >= K/(K+(eta-1)|O*\S|) f(O*)；再用 |O*\S| <= min{K,n-K} 得 C*_{n,K}。两族紧实例（adversary 族与逐 j 的 modular 族）用 Fraction 精确核对，逐实例界在 n<=5,K<=3 的 LP 网格上与最坏值逐格相等。randomized 方面：陈述里不含 random string，把 deterministic 去掉后同一族只给出 C* 乘以 (n+(eta-1)h)/n 的较弱上界，所以 deterministic 这个限定词非空洞。
quantifiers: forall deterministic algorithm A with arbitrary (unbounded, adaptive) query access to tilde f — 输出 T 必须是 tilde f 这个函数的确定性函数，这是 adversary 先读 T 再选 H 的依据

output size: |T| <= K（允许 |T| > K 则结论假：取 T = N）
ground set size: 2 <= K <= n（K = 1 时构造与推导逐字仍成立，故 K >= 2 对本命题非必需）
attainment 方向：S 是在全部 K-subsets 上 maximize tilde f 的集合，query size = C(n,K)（exhaustive search，非 poly-query）
tie breaking：结论对每一个 tilde f-maximizer S 成立，故对抗 tie-breaking 无影响

key_steps: U1 构造：tilde f(A)=|A| 与 f_H(A)=eta_u|A∩H| + (1/eta_o)|A\H|，h=min{K,n-K}
U2 band 恰好 (eta_u,eta_o)：重元素在下侧取等、轻元素在上侧取等（有理精确检验，2<=n<=8 全网格）
U3 determinism：tilde f 与 H 无关，故 transcript 与 T 固定，adversary 后选 H
U4 |T|<=K 与 h<=n-K 保证存在 H 与 T 不交，f_H(T)=|T|/eta_o<=K/eta_o
U5 modular 的 optimal K-set = 全部 H 加 K-h 个轻元素，f(O*)=h eta_u+(K-h)/eta_o
U6 比值化简得 K/(K+(eta-1)h)=C*_{n,K}(eta)（sympy 恒等式）
L1 归一化：tilde f/eta_o 把 band 变成 [d/eta, d] 且不改 argmax；L2 令 r=f-tilde f，r 单调、marginal <= theta d，theta=1-1/eta
C1 主不等式 (J)：f(O*)-f(S) <= r(O*)-r(S) <= r(S∪O*)-r(S) <= theta[f(S∪O*)-f(S)]，只用 tilde f(S)>=tilde f(O*)
C2 submodular 展开：f(S∪O*)-f(S) <= sum_{o in O*\S} d_o(S)
C3 single-swap maximality + submodularity：d_o(S) <= d_o(S\s) <= eta d_s(S\s) 对所有 s in S
C4 sum_{s in S} d_s(S\s) <= f(S) 故 m = min_s d_s(S\s) <= f(S)/K
C5 合并 C1-C4 并用 theta*eta = eta-1 得 f(S) >= K/(K+(eta-1)j) f(O*)，j=|O*\S|
C6 j <= min{K,n-K} 且 x -> K/(K+(eta-1)x) 不增，得 >= C*_{n,K}(eta)
C7 紧性：逐 j 的 modular 族（S 元素权重 1，j 个权重 eta，tilde w 全相等）比值恰为 K/(K+(eta-1)j)
R1 randomized：同一族的 Yao 值 = C* * (n+(eta-1)h)/n > C*，故 deterministic 非空洞限定词
N1 反例候选说明只用成对不等式不够：n=4,K=3,eta=2 有 f 满足全部成对必要条件、比值 5/7 < 3/4，但无相容 tilde f（LP infeasible）

C.name: C6 app:ceiling adversary for K <= n < 2K has ratio exactly K/(K+(eta-1)min{K,n-K})
C.detail: [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE] 198 instances (K=1..5, n=K..2K-1, 14 splits), 68,892 monotonicity, 119,116 submodularity, 68,892 band pairs. Ratio equals C*_{n,K}(eta) exactly (Fractions) and the smallest band factors are exactly (eta_u, eta_o). At n = K the calibrated mixed-weight variant is used: output is the whole ground set, ratio exactly 1. Scope note: at n = K = 1 a single element carries one weight, so both error ends coincide only at eta = 1; the statement assumes 2 <= K <= n, so the both-ends requirement is not applied on those 12 grid points (ratio and validity still checked).

D_structured: eta = 1: PASS. C* = 1 on every (n,K) checked; 144 random instances with ftilde = c f have actual eta exactly 1 and the ftilde-argmax K-set is exactly optimal.
eta = K: PASS. At n = 2K the adversary ratio is 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 for K = 2, 3, 4, equal to C* in each case.
n = 2K: PASS. The two branches K/((2K-n)+(n-K)eta) and 1/eta agree at n = 2K on all 14 splits for K = 1..4; the adversary at eta = 3/2 gives ratio 2/3 for K = 1..4.
n = K (output the whole ground set): PASS. C* = 1 and the ratio is exactly 1 on every split; the calibrated mixed-weight variant still attains both error ends for K = 2..5.
n = 2K-1: PASS. C* = K/(1+(K-1)eta) is attained exactly; at eta = 3/2 the values are 4/5, 3/4, 8/11, 5/7 for K = 2, 3, 4, 5.
oracle.D_worst: Worst slack is 0 everywhere, i.e. the inequalities are tight at several points and never violated. Attainment side, per-instance form: slack = 0 at C2, n=2, K=1, eta=372/227, a=0, ratio 1 vs bound 1, family concave_cardinality. Attainment side, global form f(S) >= OPT/eta: slack = 0 at C2, n=5, K=1, eta=1, ratio 1 vs bound 1, family budget_additive. Upper-bound side: 1/eta minus the largest ratio over disjoint T equals 0 at C1, K=2, n=4, (eta_u,eta_o)=(1,1). Largest ratio among the three algorithm types in C3 is 1 at K=1, n=2, eta=1 (bound 1). Total runtime 55.0 s, 9 checks, 0 failed, 0 violations, exit code 0. Every decision uses fractions.Fraction or sympy; floats appear only in printed text and inside the rerun J5 script. Seeds fixed (C2=20260918, C5=20260919, eta1=20260920, alg=20260921). No existing repo file was modified and git was never run.

Implementation note on criterion C(a): the results/J4 scripts were never delivered, so the exactness check was implemented from scratch in ceiling.py. The random legal ftilde generator exploits the fact that Definition 1's constraints are exactly the pairs (S, S+e), so processing the lattice by cardinality and picking ftilde(T) inside the intersection of the |T| intervals enforces every band constraint; infeasible intersections are rejected and counted (2,830 rejections in C2, 966 in C5).

Two items are not exact and are labelled as such. (1) The 52 full-lattice algorithm-side LPs inside the rerun J5 script use scipy.optimize.linprog with a 1e-8 tolerance, so that item carries [VERIFIED-LP 浮点]; the same script's 14 sympy identities, 24 modular adversary instances (37,056 all-pairs gains) and 16 K=4 dual certificates are exact Fractions. (2) Nothing in ceiling.py itself is float-decided.

Residual gaps the oracle does not close, carried forward unchanged from ledger T8: the general exchange summation, telescoping and minimax quantifier assembly stays [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED] (source J5 batch A) since this script checks finite instance families plus symbolic identities, not arbitrary n and K; the randomized minimax value stays [OPEN].

One conservative scope decision, recorded rather than asked about: at n = K = 1 the ground set carries a single weight, so both error ends are attainable only at eta = 1. The statement assumes 2 <= K <= n and the appendix calibration needs at least two elements, so the both-ends-attained requirement is not applied on those 12 grid points; the ratio and the monotone-submodular validity are still checked there and pass.

blind.conclusion_restated: 对任意 monotone submodular f（f(∅)=0，取值非负）、任意 set function 形式的 predictor f̃、任意 1<=K<=n，predictive greedy 恰好跑 K 步（ties 由对手打破）输出 T=S^K，其 selection error η^sel（按输入文件的三分支定义，取值 [1,∞]，约定 L_K(∞)=0）满足 f(T) >= L_K(η^sel) f(O*) >= (1-e^{-1/η^sel}) f(O*)，其中 L_K(x)=1-(1-1/(xK))^K。推导路线是经典 greedy 分析配 α-approximate incremental oracle（α=η^sel）：由 monotone+submodular 的覆盖引理得 f(O*)-f(S^t) <= K·M_t，由 selection error 定义得 M_t <= η^sel·g_t，合成递推 Δ_{t+1} <= (1-1/(Kη^sel))Δ_t，归纳 K 次并用 Δ_0=f(O*) 得结论；第二个不等式来自 1-u <= e^{-u}。若 predictor 另有有限 (η_u,η_o) 误差，则轨迹上的 band 配合 greedy 的 argmax 性质给出 M_t <= η^tr·g_t 从而 η^sel <= η^tr，而轨迹状态集是全体子集的子族给出 η^tr <= η，再由 L_K 在 [1,∞] 上单调不增（dL/dx = -(1-1/(xK))^{K-1}/x^2 <= 0）得 L_K(η^sel) >= L_K(η^tr) >= L_K(η)，同一个界在三个参数下逐次变弱但都成立。整条手写链标 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]，并有 sympy 符号验证（递推展开与导数恒等式，[VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]）与精确有理数穷举（一个 K=3 精确取等的 coverage 实例 + 400 个随机实例，[VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]）支持。
quantifiers: for all f: 一切 monotone submodular、f(∅)=0、取值于 R_{>=0} 的目标；monotone 与 submodular 两者都是本质的（去掉 monotone 则 d_e(S) 可负，M_t>=g_t>=0 与覆盖引理同时失效；去掉 submodular 则 diminishing-returns 求和失效）
for all f̃: 一切满足 f̃(∅)=0 的 set function；第一个不等式对 f̃ 不加任何精度假设，f̃ 只通过它产生的那条轨迹进入结论；第二段才需要有限 (η_u,η_o)
任取 O*: 任一 optimal K-set；证明只用 |O*\S| <= K 与 f(O*) 的值，故同一证明给出 f(T) >= L_K(η^sel) f(A) 对任意 |A| <= K 成立，optimality 只用于把 f(O*) 读作 F^OPT
n >= K >= 1: 即 1 <= K <= n。K > n 时第 n 步的 argmax 在空集上取，run 不良定义；K >= 1 排除空 run，K = 0 时 L_0 无定义
deterministic: 算法确定，唯一自由度是 ties；结论对每一条执行轨迹逐点成立，不是对期望成立。对手 tie breaking 不破坏结论，因为 η^sel 按实际轨迹计算，对手只能抬高它从而让不等式变弱
query size: 只用 single-element 的 f̃ 的边际增益，每步 <= n 次 query，共 <= nK 次；不需要 all-pairs 或大集合 query。该限定不改变真值但刻画了 η^sel 的来源
tie breaking: 所有 worst-case 陈述里由对手打破；第 3.3 节的紧实例在 t=0 正是靠对手 tie 才走进 decoy 分支，t=1,2 则严格胜出
恰好 K 步: run 不提前停止，某步最大 predicted gain 为 0 时仍然选；这是归纳长度等于 L_K 指数的原因，提前停止的变体不在本命题范围
η^sel 的定义域: [1,∞]，含 ∞；它是 run 的函数而非 instance 的函数。分支 a_t=∞（g_t=0<M_t）必须单列，否则 M_t <= η^sel g_t 在 g_t=0 时不可能成立；约定 L_K(∞)=0 使该情形退化为 f(T) >= 0
η 与 η^tr 的定义域: η=η_u η_o >= 1（convention B），η^tr 同取 [1,∞]；只要轨迹上存在某个 d_e(S)>0，band 非空即强制乘积 >= 1
L_K 的定义域: x ∈ [1,∞]，此时 xK >= 1，底数 1-1/(xK) ∈ [0,1)；若允许 x < 1/K 底数为负，偶数 K 会给出 L_K > 1，命题失真
worst-case: 结论是逐 instance 逐轨迹的下界，不含任何 tightness 断言；第 3.3 节的取等实例只是额外证据
key_steps: Step 1 run 良定义：|S^t|=t 且 t <= K-1 <= n-1，故每步 argmax 与 M_t 都在非空候选集上取（用 1 <= K <= n）
Step 2 monotone 给 d_e(S) >= 0 且 e_t ∉ S^t 给 g_t <= M_t，故 a_t >= 1，η^sel ∈ [1,∞]
Step 3 η^sel=∞ 或 f(O*)=0 的平凡情形由 L_K(∞)=0 与 f >= 0 直接闭合
Step 4 per-step 不等式 M_t <= η^sel g_t，按 selection error 的三个分支分别验证（第三分支与 η^sel 有限矛盾）
Step 5 覆盖引理 f(O*)-f(S) <= Σ_{e∈O*\S} d_e(S) <= K·max_{e∉S} d_e(S)，用 monotone（f(O*) <= f(O*∪S)）+ telescoping + diminishing returns + |O*\S| <= K
Step 6 取 S=S^t 合并 Step 4/5：Δ_t <= K η^sel g_t = K η^sel (Δ_t - Δ_{t+1})
Step 8 归纳 K 次得 Δ_K <= (1-c)^K Δ_0（不需要 Δ_t >= 0，只需 1-c >= 0）；sympy 对 K=1..8 验证展开式等于 L_K [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 9 Δ_0 = f(O*)（用 f(∅)=0）得 f(T) >= L_K(η^sel) f(O*)
Step 10 由 1-u <= e^{-u}（u=1/(xK) ∈ (0,1]，底数非负可 K 次幂保序）得 L_K(x) >= 1-e^{-1/x}；精确有理网格 K<=12、x∈[1,10] 最小间隙 3.79e-4 > 0
Step 11 dL_K/dx = -(1-1/(xK))^{K-1}/x^2 <= 0（sympy 对符号 K 验证）加上 lim_{x→∞} L_K = 0 = L_K(∞)，故 L_K 在 [1,∞] 单调不增 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 12 给出 η^tr 的形式定义（band 只在 S^0..S^{K-1} 上要求，两因子各取最紧值相乘并以 1 截断）；这是本文补加的假设
Step 13 η^sel <= η^tr：由 greedy 的 argmax 得 f̃ 增益 e_t >= e*，再上下夹 M_t/η_u^tr <= f̃ 值 <= η_o^tr g_t，得 M_t <= η^tr g_t，三个分支逐一核对
Step 14 η^tr <= η：轨迹状态集是 2^N 的子族，两个因子的 max 各自取在子族上
Step 15 串联 Step 9/11/13/14 得 f(T) >= L_K(η^sel) f(O*) >= L_K(η^tr) f(O*) >= L_K(η) f(O*) >= (1-e^{-1/η}) f(O*)

blind.conclusion_restated: lem:coherence 的两项 (i) 和 (ii) 都可以只从 Definition 1 的 band 推出，核心杠杆是 f 和 f-tilde 各自满足的交换恒等式 d_e(S)+d_{e'}(S+e) = d_{e'}(S)+d_e(S+e')。由 f-tilde 的这条恒等式，假设 d̃_e(S) >= d̃_{e'}(S) 精确地转成 d̃_e(S+e') - d̃_{e'}(S+e) = d̃_e(S) - d̃_{e'}(S) >= 0（order transfer，无常数损失）；再对 d_e(S+e') 用 band 上界、对 d_{e'}(S+e) 用 band 下界，得到 eta_o d_e(S+e') >= d̃_e(S+e') >= d̃_{e'}(S+e) >= d_{e'}(S+e)/eta_u，除以 eta_o 即 (i)。(ii) 与 (i) 由 f 的交换恒等式严格等价：(1-1/eta)C - (B-A) = D - C/eta 是一条恒等式，所以两者同时成立、同时取等，并非两条独立事实。submodularity 在 (i)(ii) 中完全未被使用（LP 删掉 C<=B 与 D<=A 两行后最小值仍为 0）；monotonicity 的作用是 soundness 前提，保证 eta>1 时 band 的两端次序不颠倒、结论不退化。sharp form 方面：常数 1/eta 与 1-1/eta 都不可改进，对每个 eta>=1 和每个 c in (0,eta] 有一族严格 submodular 的两元素取等实例；取等的充要条件由松弛分解 eta_o D - C/eta_u = (eta_o D - D̃) + (Ã - B̃) + (C̃ - C/eta_u) 三项同时为零给出。需要 submodularity 的只有 min 形式 B-A <= (1-1/eta) min{C, B} 中把 min 认定为 C 的那一条，即 diminishing-returns 不等式 d_{e'}(S+e) <= d_{e'}(S) 本身；删掉 submodularity 后精确 LP 给出 min(B-C) = -1/2 < 0，而 (i)(ii) 与弱形式 (1-1/eta)B >= B-A 三者最小值仍为 0。另外发现一条必需条件：f-tilde 必须是集合函数（其交换恒等式必须成立），删掉这一行后 min(eta D - C) = -1/6 < 0，见证点 A=1/3,B=1/2,C=1/6,D=0,Ã=B̃=1/2,C̃=1/6,D̃=0，即仅靠逐点 band 推不出本引理。
quantifiers: forall n >= 1 与 forall 基集 N：引理对 n 无依赖，只需 N 含 S 与 e,e'，即 n >= |S|+2；模型里的 n >= K 对本引理空洞
forall K with 1 <= K <= n：引理陈述中不出现 K，去掉后真值不变，对本引理空洞
forall f: 2^N -> R_{>=0}，f(empty)=0，monotone；模型另设 submodular，但 (i)(ii) 的推导不使用 submodularity（已用 LP 删行验证）
forall f-tilde: 2^N -> R，f-tilde(empty)=0；不假设单调、submodular 或非负；唯一用到的性质是 f-tilde 为集合函数（该性质必需，删掉后结论为假）
eta_u, eta_o 的定义域：逐字版 Definition 1 要求 eta_u, eta_o >= 1，convention B 要求 eta_u, eta_o > 0；推导只用 eta_u > 0 且 eta_o > 0，两种约定下一致，LP 中同时测了 eta_o < 1 与 eta_u < 1 的 split

key_steps: Step 1：f 的交换恒等式 A+C = B+D（等价 C-D = B-A），只用 f 是集合函数，telescoping [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 2：f-tilde 的同一条交换恒等式 Ã+C̃ = B̃+D̃，只用 f-tilde 是集合函数 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 3：order transfer，由 Step 2 与假设得 D̃ - C̃ = Ã - B̃ >= 0，即 d̃_e(S+e') >= d̃_{e'}(S+e)，无常数损失
Step 4：两侧各用一次 band，得链 eta_o D >= D̃ >= C̃ >= C/eta_u，除以 eta_o 即 (i) [VERIFIED-LP，9 组 split 最小值皆为 0]
Step 5：由 Step 1 得恒等式 (1-1/eta)C - (B-A) = D - C/eta，故 (i) 与 (ii) 等价且同时取等，(ii) 随之成立 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 6：同一状态上用 band 得 B <= eta A，进而 B-A <= (1-1/eta)B，此为 (ii) 的弱形式，同样不需要 submodularity [VERIFIED-LP]
Step 7：松弛分解恒等式 eta_o D - C/eta_u = (eta_o D - D̃) + (Ã - B̃) + (C̃ - C/eta_u)，三项各自非负 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]

Sharp form (S2)：常数 1/eta 不可改进，显式族 A=1, C=c, B=1+c(1-1/eta), D=c/eta（c in (0,eta]，c<eta 时严格 submodular）对每个 eta 取等 [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE + VERIFIED-LP]
Sharp form (S3)：min 形式 B-A <= (1-1/eta) min{C, B}，两支各自只需 band；submodularity 只用于判定 min = C，即 (ii) 是更强的一支
Sharp form (S4)：取等充要条件为 Step 7 的三项松弛同时为零，即 D̃ = eta_o D、Ã = B̃、C̃ = C/eta_u

Total runtime 27.3s, exit 0, 12/12 checks PASS.

Two substantive findings for the ledger T5 card:

1. Parts (i) and (ii) are not "(i) implies (ii)" but the SAME inequality. Because the f exchange identity d_e(S+e') = d + h - g is an identity, the slack of (i), the slack of (ii) and the slack of the sharp-form first inequality are one and the same rational function [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC, C0; checked to exact equality on all 185,272 triples in C1/C2]. The appendix app:coherence step "substituting part (i)" is therefore an identical rewriting, not a strengthening. The card and the appendix could say so.

2. Wording correction to the T5 must-not-claim line. The card reads "它用到离轨状态 S∪{e} 的误差带" but the off-trajectory state the proof actually uses is S∪{e'} (the state where the NOT-selected element was added; it carries the upper band in the third step of (i)). S∪{e} is the next run state and is on-trajectory. The prohibition itself is correct and now has an exact witness (D4a) plus a count (D4b, 15 of 451).

Also recorded: parts (i) and (ii) need only monotonicity of f (verified on 1200 monotone non-submodular instances); only the second sharp-form inequality needs submodularity, and D5 gives the exact instance where it fails without it.

Exactness caveat: the two rerun repository scripts contain HiGHS float LPs, so C3's facet item and C4's R6_full_lattice_lp minimum slacks are tagged [VERIFIED-LP 浮点] rather than exact (two of the nine reported minima are -6.66e-16 and -1.11e-16, i.e. solver noise at zero). Every decision made inside coherence.py itself is exact (Fraction or sympy); floats appear only in printouts.

Convention note that materially sharpens the test: the realized band factors are not floored at 1 (convention B of definition1.md), so eta = eta_u*eta_o is the smallest admissible scalar error, which maximizes 1/eta in (i) and minimizes (1-1/eta) in (ii). An earlier draft that floored the factors made the test strictly weaker and also broke the eta = 1 structured case.

Suggestion: add one sentence to app:coherence saying where it is or is not used; do not delete it from the statement.

blind.conclusion_restated: 对每个整数 K>=2 与每个实数 eta in [1,infty)，在 adversarial tie breaking 下 predictive greedy 的精确最坏比是 rho_K(eta) = min_{0<=j<=K-1} V_j(eta)，其中 k1=(K-1)eta+1、q=(K-1)eta/k1、V_j(eta)=1-q^j(1-(K-j)/(K eta))；最小值由 V_j 在 eta in [K-j, K-j+1] 上取到（j=0 时为 [K,infty)），断点是整数 2,...,K，且 rho_K(eta)=1/eta 当且仅当 eta>=K。下界方向：用 predictor band 在两个非轨迹状态上的一致性导出逐步不等式 m_{o,t} <= g_t + (1-1/eta) m_{o,t+1}（它严格强于常用的 M_t <= eta g_t，是 k1=(K-1)eta+1 的唯一来源），与覆盖不等式一起给出一个只依赖 K 的 LP relaxation，再给出显式 dual multipliers，其目标值恰为 V_j 且非负性的两个边界恰好是 segment 的两个端点。上界方向：给出闭式 attaining family，f 是一个 2K 元 coverage function（j 个 head 元素吃 O* 的对称切片、K-j 个 tail 元素私有），predictor 为 f~ = f - (1-1/eta) max_i mu(A_{o_i} cap C(S))，它在全部 (S,e) 上满足 Definition 1 的 band，且在每一步与全部 o_i 形成 full tie。K<=4 的闭式与陈述逐字一致。
quantifiers: K: 整数 K>=2 全称（K=1 时数值公式仍给 1/eta，但断点集合为空，故 K>=2 属陈述卫生而非数学必需）
eta: 实数域 [1, infty) 全称；eta>=1 由 Definition 1 的 eta_u,eta_o>=1 强制；eta=1 允许；eta=infty 不在域内
f: 一切 monotone submodular 且 f(empty)=0 的 f 全称；F_OPT=max_{|T|=K} f(T)；F_OPT=0 时按 assumptions.md 平凡成立
f~: 一切满足 Definition 1（single-element, multiplicative，band 在全部 2^n·n 个 (S,e) 上）的 f~ 全称；不要求 f~ submodular（本证明的 attaining predictor 确实不是 submodular）
算法: predictive greedy，deterministic 单步贪心，query 只作用于 f~，query size 为单元素边际增益，恰好执行 K 步（不提前停止）
tie breaking: adversarial；非空洞，attaining instance 每一步都是 e_t 与全部 o_i 预测增益严格相等的 full tie，改成偏向 O* 的规则则同一实例比值变 1
n: 下界方向对一切 n>=K 一致成立（LP relaxation 规模只依赖 K）；上界方向 attaining instances 用 n=2K，故 rho_K 读作 inf_{n>=K} rho_{n,K} 时 inf 在 n=2K 取到
j: min 遍历 0<=j<=K-1；加入 j=K 不改变 min（V_K-V_{K-1}=q^{K-1}(1/k1-1/(K eta))>=0）；最小化者 j*(eta)=clamp(ceil(K-eta), 0, K-1)
存在量词（上界）: 对每个 (K,eta) 存在一个 n=2K 的实例与一个 tie-breaking 选择使比值恰为 min_j V_j；对每个 j 存在实例恰好实现 V_j
key_steps: Step 1 归一化：比值对 f 齐次、greedy 对 f~ 正标量不变，故 WLOG F_OPT=1 且 (eta_u,eta_o)=(eta,1)，band 写成 d/eta <= d~ <= d
Step 2 Lemma A：由 argmax 与 band 得 M_t <= eta g_t（即 eta^sel <= eta）；单靠它只能得到 L_K(eta)，严格小于 rho_K（K=3,eta=2 时 91/216 < 7/15）

Step 3 Lemma B（关键）：f~ 是集合函数给出 f~(S+e+o) 的两条链相等，配合 argmax 得 d~_o(S+e) <= d~_e(S+o)，再两侧用 band 得 d_o(S+e) <= eta d_e(S+o)，代入 f 的恒等式 d_e(S+o)=d_e(S)+d_o(S+e)-d_o(S) 得 m_{o,t} <= g_t + (1-1/eta) m_{o,t+1}；它蕴含 Lemma A
Step 4 覆盖不等式：monotone+submodular 给 1 <= f(S^t) + sum_i m_{i,t}
Step 5 LP relaxation (P)：任一 run 是 (A_t)(B_t)(C_t) 的可行点且目标等于 F_ALG，规模只依赖 K，故 rho_K >= val(P) 对一切 n>=K
Step 6 聚合：令 P_t=sum_i m_{i,t}，逐 i 与聚合等价（回代 m_{i,t}=P_t/K）
Step 7 dual 证书：由 complementary slackness 反解出 z_t、w_t、y_t 的闭式，w_j>=0 等价于 eta>=K-j，y_j>=0 等价于 eta<=K-j+1，恰好给出 segment 两端点；sympy 对 K=2..7 全部 j 符号验证可行 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 8 dual 目标值：sum_t y_t = 1-(K-1)z_0 = V_j(eta)，故 rho_K >= V_j（weak duality）[VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 9 段结构：c_j=q^j(1-(K-j)/(K eta)) 满足 c_{j+1}>=c_j 等价于 eta<=K-j，故 c_j 单峰、j*=ceil(K-eta)，断点为整数 2..K，且 rho_K=1/eta 当且仅当 eta>=K [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 10 下界合并：rho_K(eta) >= min_j V_j(eta) 对一切 n>=K
Step 11 attaining f：n=2K 的 coverage function，atom 表为 a(i,s)=g_s/K（head 切片）、a(i,inf)=R_j/K、tau_t=R_j/(K eta)（tail 私有）
Step 12 attaining predictor：f~ = f - (1-1/eta) max_i mu(A_{o_i} cap C(S))；band 由 max 的次可加性与 A_{o_i} 两两不交得证，对全部 (S,e) 成立
Step 13 F_OPT=1：任一 K-set 的值 <= r/K + (1-r/K)[(1-R_j)+R_j/eta] <= 1
Step 14 greedy 轨迹：用恒等式 K+(eta-1)(K-1)=k1 得 head 步 d~_{e_t}=d~_{o_i}=R_t/(K eta)，tail 步同为 R_j/(K eta)，每步 full tie，adversary 选 e_t
Step 15 F_ALG=(1-R_j)+(K-j)R_j/(K eta)=V_j；sympy 对 K=2..8 符号验证，Fraction 对 K=2..5 逐 S 逐 e 穷举验证 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC / VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]
Step 16 合并得 rho_K=min_j V_j，展开出的 K=2,3,4 闭式与陈述逐字一致；另以 (f,f~) 为变量的完整实例 LP 在 22 个格点独立复核（浮点，误差 <=3e-16）[VERIFIED-LP]

blind.conclusion_restated: 对每个固定实数 eta >= 1，令 c_j = 1 - (K-j)/(K eta)，h_K(j) = q^j c_j（q = (K-1)eta/k_1，k_1 = (K-1)eta+1），则 V_j = 1 - h_K(j) 且 rho_K = 1 - max_{0<=j<=K} h_K(j)。可以给出：(1) L_K(eta) = 1 - (1 - 1/(eta K))^K 关于整数 K 严格递减并收敛到 1 - e^{-1/eta}（方向即 "monotone"，为递减）；(2) 一步差分恒等式 h_K(j) - h_K(j-1) = q^{j-1}(K - eta + 1 - j)/(K eta k_1) 给出 h_K 关于 j 的 unimodality 与 argmax 闭式 j*_K = max{0, K - ceil(eta) + 1}，由此 rho_K = 1/eta 当且仅当 K <= floor(eta)（plateau），且 K > eta 时 rho_K <= V_1 < V_0 = 1/eta；(3) 对 K >= ceil(eta) 有闭式 Lambda(K) = max_j h_K(j) = ((K-1)eta/((K-1)eta+1))^{K-ceil(eta)+1} (1 - (ceil(eta)-1)/(K eta))，换元 t = k_1 后 d(ln Lambda)/dt = -Sigma(t)/eta + (1-s)/(t(t-1)) + s/((t+eta-1-s)(t+eta-1))（s = ceil(eta)-1，Sigma(t) = sum_{i>=2} 1/(i t^i)），用 Sigma(t) < 1/(2t(t-1)) 与 s < eta <= 2eta-1 化为充分条件 K(2eta-1)/(2eta) >= s 并由 K >= s+1 成立，故 Lambda 严格递增、rho_K 从 K >= floor(eta) 起严格递减、全局非增；(4) 对所有 K, j 有 h_K(j) <= e^{-1/eta}（用 q^j <= e^{-j/k_1} <= e^{-j/(K eta)} 与 g(x) = e^{-x/eta}(1-(1-x)/eta) 在 [0,1] 上不减），故 rho_K >= 1 - e^{-1/eta}；结合 rho_K <= V_K = U_K(eta) = 1 - q^K -> 1 - e^{-1/eta} 夹逼得 rho_K -> 1 - e^{-1/eta}，且两条曲线都从上方逼近。恒等式部分为 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]，全部单调性/plateau/argmax/上界结论在 17 个 eta 值与 K <= 60 的 exact rational 网格上为 [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]，一般参数域的论证为 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]。

oracle.notes: All four clauses of cor:limit are supported by the oracle within the checked ranges, with 0 FAILED items. Exactness: every decision uses fractions.Fraction or sympy; e^{-1/eta} never enters a decision as a float, it is bracketed by a 60-term alternating Taylor series (terms are non-increasing since 1/eta <= 1 for eta >= 1, so consecutive partial sums bracket the value), and all comparisons are rational. The only non-exact item in the whole report is inside the rerun repo script: results/H_B_asymptotic.py section 0 cross-checks the closed form against code/reduced_lp.py, which calls scipy linprog, so that item is marked [VERIFIED-LP 浮点] (deviation 3.331e-16); its sections 2, 5, 6 (sympy) and section 4 (exact Fraction differences) are exact. (2) No existing repo file was modified and git was never run. Caveats to carry into the ledger: every rho_K statement goes through the closed form rho_K = min_j V_j and is therefore conditional on thm:exact (T6), which was not reproved here; C4/C5/C6/D are finite-range exhaustions (K <= 200 or K <= 61 over finite eta grids) and do not constitute a proof for all K and all eta, so monotonicity at infinity still rests on the app:asymptotics derivative argument whose passage from the continuous derivative to discrete differences (including branch switches at integer eta) and whose tail-bound assembly remain [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED], matching ledger T9; C3b only shows |R_K| <= 0.234 on K in [10, 800] at 7 eta values, so no claim is made that the O(1/K^2) remainder is uniform in eta or has an explicit constant (a T9 must-not-claim). blind.conclusion_restated: 在严格隔离（只读四个 inputs 文件，未读 HANDOFF/paper/ledger，未用 web/git）下重建了 thm:linear-exact 的硬度路线：硬族必须用一个 1-blind predictor，即 $\tilde f_\pi(S)=\varphi(|S|)$ 当 $|S\cap\pi|\le1$，而在 $|S\cap\pi|\ge2$ 处自由；$f_\pi(S)=\Phi(|S\cap\pi|,|S\setminus\pi|)$ 由 count grid 经引理 A 得到 monotone submodular。确定性论证由三步组成：canonical-transcript induction（deterministic + 1-blind 使查询序列与输出 $T$ 与 $\pi$ 无关）、union bound（可见事件 $\le nK\binom K2\frac{K(K-1)}{n(n-1)}=\frac{K^3(K-1)^2}{2(n-1)}\le K^5/(2n)$，命中事件 $\le K^2/n$，和 $=\varepsilon_n$，在 $n\ge4K^5$ 时 $\le5/32<1$ 故存在好的 $\pi^\ast$）、以及族上的值 $\Phi(0,K)\le\rho_K$。我独立复现出的两个计数常数与陈述中的 $\varepsilon_n=K^2/n+K^5/(2n)$ 逐项吻合，这也解释了 $n\ge4K^5$ 的作用（使 $\varepsilon_n<1$，给出无渐近的确定性存在性）。数值侧：exact LP 给出 predictive greedy 的最坏比在 $(K,\eta)=(2,3/2)$ 为 $3/5$、$(3,3/2)$ 为 $9/16$，与 $\min_jV_j$ 一致且严格高于 $L_K$；$L_K$ 不可达的机制被定位为 $\tilde f$ 作为集合函数的一致性耦合（给出 $K=2$ 的精确有理矛盾 $1/6<2/9$，与 split 无关）。1-blind 族在 $K=3$ 的 per-T/all-T/avg-T 三个量都恰为 $0.5625=\rho_3$；$K=2$ 的 per-T 为 $0.6=\rho_2$（确定性条款成立）但 avg-T 为 $0.61$，故我的族在 $K=2$ 的随机化条款上在 $n>2000$ 处达不到 $\rho_2+\varepsilon_n$。一般 $(K,\eta)$ 的基实例、band 向 $|S|>K$ 的显式延拓、以及"最小因子恰好 $(\eta_u,\eta_o)$"的紧性核验未闭合；保证侧 thm:exact 按路线二规则作为外部输入未重证。

oracle.notes:
Overall: 29 checks, 0 FAILED, 0 violations, 16.2 s, seed 20260918, exit code 0. All decisions in fractions.Fraction or sympy; floats only in printed parentheses. No existing repository file was modified and git was never run.

Main finding for the handoff question (C5). The counting chain literally as written (relaxing K(K-1)/(n(n-1)) to (K/n)^2) yields n > K^5/2 + K^2, so the smallest admissible n is floor(K^5/2 + K^2) + 1 (K=2: 21, K=3: 131, K=4: 529). Keeping the exact pair probability yields the quadratic n^2 - (A+B+1)n + B > 0 with A = K^3(K-1)^2/2 and B = K^2, whose larger root always lies in (A+B, A+B+1); hence the smallest admissible n is exactly K^3(K-1)^2/2 + K^2 + 1. So the handoff figure K^3(K-1)^2/2 + K^2 is the strict threshold of the tight chain and is one below the smallest n the chain actually admits. Either way n >= 4K^5 is a sufficient, comfortably loose choice whose role is to force the total down to the constant 5/32.

Scope limits recorded rather than papered over. (1) The assembly steps stay [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED, source J6] as the ledger T10c prescribes: C4/C5 verify only the algebra of the chain, and D1/D2 verify only finitely many concrete algorithms (56 structured cases, 500 random strategies) on this family; finite computation cannot range over all adaptive deterministic algorithms. Nothing was upgraded. (2) "greedy + one swap pass" keeps every query at size <= K but uses about 2nK queries, over the nK budget; that is recorded in the JSON field within_budget and the in_class flag is set to false for it. The adversary still found an admissible O and the ratio was still exactly rho_K; restoring it to the class would need the union bound over its real query count, which at n >= 4K^5 gives 2*(1/8) + 1/32 = 9/32 < 1. (3) max(forward greedy, backward/deletion greedy) is out of class because deletion greedy queries sets of size up to n-1; it was evaluated directly on the real instance over 8 placements of O (lowest, highest, 6 seeded random). With O on the lowest indices it reaches ratio 1 = OPT, but the adversary can pick a placement that holds it to exactly rho_K in all 8 configurations. That records the qualifier as load bearing for the proof route (the transcript argument is placement independent, this candidate is not) without claiming anything about arbitrary-size queries, which remain [OPEN] per ledger T12. (4) The general-K root-location argument of C5c' is tagged [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]; the per-K conclusions for K = 2..12 are exhaustively verified. (5) The adversary's O search always succeeded on the first, deterministic, degree-ordered greedy pass, so the seeded random restarts never decided anything.

No item had to be marked [VERIFIED-LP floating point]; no LP solver was needed, every check is symbolic or exact-rational exhaustion.

blind.conclusion_restated: 独立（盲审）推导 thm:hardness 的结果分三块。值公式一块完全闭合并有 oracle：$H_{K,\tau}(\eta)=1-(1-\frac{1}{\eta(K-\tau)+1})^K$ 恒等于 $L_K(\bar\theta)$，其中 $\bar\theta=\frac{\eta(K-\tau)+1}{K}$（sympy 差为 0）；statement 中那句 "so that $\bar\theta\ge1$" 与假设 $\eta\ge\frac{K-1}{K-\tau}$ 严格等价（需 $K>\tau$）；一致性 $H_{K,\tau}(\eta)\ge L_K(\eta)$ 在 $K\le12$ 的精确有理网格上无反例；$K\to\infty$ 时 $H\to1-e^{-1/\eta}$（sympy limit）。结构一块可以讲清但无显式构造：硬族必须是"hidden $K$-set $O^\ast$ + 在 window $\mathcal W_\tau=\{|S|\le K,|S\cap O^\ast|\le\tau-1\}$ 内 oblivious 的 $\tilde f(S)=\Psi(|S|)$"，因为全域 oblivious 会在 $|S\cap O^\ast|=K-1$ 处违反 band；band 的唯一作用是把同一状态下 hidden 与 dummy 的真增益比锁在 $\eta$ 内；在临界状态 $|S\cap O^\ast|=\tau-1$ 上 $|O^\ast\setminus S|=K-\tau+1$，submodularity 的 telescoping 上界给 $R\le(K-\tau)\eta g+g=(\eta(K-\tau)+1)g$，即每步至少吃掉剩余的 $\beta=\frac{1}{\eta(K-\tau)+1}$，$K$ 步几何衰减 ratio $1-\beta$ 得终值 $1-(1-\beta)^K$，这正是 $\eta(K-\tau)+1$ 与 $K$ 次幂的来历（$U_K$ 的 $\eta(K-1)+1$ 是 $\tau=1$ 的同一计数）。第三块给不出：(a) 隐藏引理的 union bound 我得到 $\Pr[\exists i:|S_i\cap O^\ast|\ge\tau]\le\frac{K^{2\tau}}{\tau!\,n^{\tau-c}}$，充分条件是 $n\ge4K^{2\tau}$；它在 $c=0,\tau=1$ 时与 stated 的 $n\ge4K^{c+2}=4K^2$ 完全相同（概率恰好压到 1/4），但 $c\ge1$ 时把 $n=4K^{c+2}$ 代回得 $\frac{K^c}{4(c+1)!}$，仅当 $K^c<4(c+1)!$（$c=1$ 需 $K<8$，$c=2$ 需 $K\le4$）才 $<1$，故 stated 门槛不足以支撑我的计数；(b) displayed 的 $\varepsilon_n$ 第二项逐字等于 level-$(\tau+1)$ 的 union bound，而 Step 9 的值上界需要排除的是 level-$\tau$ 事件，其概率大 $\frac{(\tau+1)n}{K^2}$ 倍，因此 $\varepsilon_n$ as displayed 不从我的论证得出，我得到的是 $\frac Kn+\frac{K^{2\tau}}{\tau!\,n^{\tau-c}}$，且第一项 $K/n$ 的来源我只能猜测为 $\Pr[e\in O^\ast]$；(c) 显式满足取等的 monotone submodular $f$ 我没有构造出来（两个自然候选都不给 $1-(1-\beta)^K$ 的形状）。劈分从句可独立闭合：由 convention B 的缩放规则取 $\kappa=\eta_u/\eta_u^0$ 即实现任意 $\eta_u\eta_o=\eta$，但这依赖 convention B 允许因子小于 1，论文 verbatim 文本（两因子下界 1）下只能实现 $\eta_u\in[1,\eta]$。$K\delta(\theta)\to\tau-1/\theta$ 无法检验，$\delta,\theta,a_\theta,\Psi$ 的定义不在输入包内。
quantifiers: 对所有实数 c>=0，由此定义 tau = ceil(c)+1（整数 c 时 tau=c+1，一般地 tau-c>=1）
key_steps: Step 1：代入 L_K(x)=1-(1-1/(xK))^K，x=thetabar=(eta(K-tau)+1)/K，得 H=L_K(thetabar)（sympy 差为 0）[VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 2：K>tau 下 thetabar>=1 等价于 eta>=(K-1)/(K-tau)，即 statement 的假设本身，等价含义是 beta<=1/K [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
Step 3：eta*tau>=1 推出 H>=L_K(eta)（hardness 不低于 guarantee），K<=12 有理网格穷举 0 反例 [VERIFIED-EXHAUSTIVE]
Step 4：硬族形状必须是 hidden O* 加 window W_tau={|S|<=K, |S∩O*|<=tau-1} 内 oblivious 的 f~(S)=Psi(|S|)；全域 oblivious 在 |S∩O*|=K-1 处违反 band [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 5：window 内 f~ 对两元素给同一预测增益，Definition 1 的 band 两两相除给 max/min d <= eta_u*eta_o = eta，这是 eta 进入构造的唯一入口 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 6：临界状态 |S∩O*|=tau-1 时 |O*\S|=K-tau+1，submodular telescoping 给 R <= (K-tau)*eta*g + g = (eta(K-tau)+1)g，即 g >= beta*R，beta=1/(eta(K-tau)+1) [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 7：K 步几何衰减 R_{t+1}<=(1-beta)R_t，终值 1-(1-beta)^K=H；hardness 族的作用是把每个不等号取等（取等实例未构造）[HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 8：确定性使查询序列与 O* 无关；随机 K-set 上 Pr[A⊆O*]<=(K/n)^tau，乘 binom(K,tau)<=K^tau/tau!（用到查询集合大小 <= K），再乘 Q=n^c，得 K^{2tau}/(tau! n^{tau-c})；tau-c>=1 故 n>=4K^{2tau} 充分 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 9：把输出 T 当作第 Q+1 次查询纳入 union bound，得 T ∈ W_tau，再由 Step 7 得 f(T)/f(O*)<=H；|T|<=K 与 =K 等价因 f monotone [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 10：任意劈分由 convention B 的缩放 f~ -> kappa*f~ 实现，kappa=eta_u/eta_u^0；'error 恰好 = eta' 的下界方向依赖未构造的显式实例 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]
Step 11：随机化走 Yao，bad event 概率同 Step 8；得 eps_n = K/n + K^{2tau}/(tau! n^{tau-c})，与 displayed 的 level-(tau+1) 版本不符 [FAILED]
Step 12：K->oo 时 K*ln(1-1/(eta(K-tau)+1)) -> -1/eta，故 H -> 1-e^{-1/eta}（sympy limit 确认）；K*delta(theta) 一条因定义缺失无法检验 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC / 无法检验]
数值走查：K=3,eta=3/2 只有 tau=1(c=0) 合法（tau=2 需 eta>=2），beta=1/4，残量 1,3/4,9/16,27/64，H=37/64；K=2,eta=3/2 得 beta=2/5，H=16/25；L_2(1)=3/4 与 assumptions.md 一致 [VERIFIED-SYMBOLIC]
gaps: GAP-1 [FAILED]：statement 的门槛 n>=4K^{c+2} 不足以让我的 union bound 小于 1。代入 n=4K^{c+2}（整数 c，tau=c+1）得 K^c/(4(c+1)!)，仅当 K^c<4(c+1)! 成立，即 c=1 需 K<8、c=2 需 K<=4。我能闭合的充分条件是 n>=4K^{2tau}，它在 c=0,tau=1 时与 stated 条件完全相同（都是 4K^2，概率恰为 1/4）。我试过的替代计数（binom(K,tau)binom(n-tau,K-tau)/binom(n,K)、disjoint block 候选集、按元素而非 tau-subset union）都给同阶 K^{2tau}/n^{tau-c}，指数 2tau 降不到 c+2。

GAP-2 [FAILED]：displayed 的 eps_n 第二项 K^{2tau+2}/((tau+1)! n^{tau+1-c}) 逐字等于 level-(tau+1) 的 union bound（sympy 差为 0），但 window 定义为 |S∩O*|<=tau-1 时需要排除的是 level-tau 事件，其概率大 (tau+1)n/K^2 倍。若改用 window |S∩O*|<=tau 使 level-(tau+1) 成为 bad event，则 Step 6 的计数变成 eta(K-tau-1)+1，与 H 的公式冲突。二者不能同时成立，疑似 off-by-one。
GAP-3 [CONJECTURE]：eps_n 第一项 K/n 的来源推不出。最接近的解释是 Pr[固定元素 ∈ O*]=K/n，但我的 Step 11 已把'输出集合未被查询'吸收为 Q->Q+1（代价是乘 (1+n^{-c}) 而非加 K/n）；也说不清为何不是 K^2/n（E|T∩O*| 的上界）。

GAP-4 [HAND-PROOF-UNREVIEWED]：'最小可行 error factors 之积恰好 eta' 的下界方向（存在 (S,e,e') 使 band 取等）未闭合，依赖未构造的显式 f。另外劈分从句只在 definition1.md 的 convention B 下成立；论文 verbatim 文本把两因子下界在 1，那时只有 eta_u ∈ [1,eta] 的劈分可实现，'any prescribed split' 需注明用的是哪种 convention。

GAP-5 [无法检验]：K*delta(theta) -> tau - 1/theta 无法检验，delta(theta)、theta、a_theta、Psi 的定义不在输入包里（notation.md 只把它们列为 hardness-family parameters）。bar-theta 也没有独立定义，我是从 H=L_K(bar-theta) 反解出 bar-theta=(eta(K-tau)+1)/K 的。一致性提示：K(eta-bar-theta)=eta*tau-1=eta(tau-1/eta)，与目标式差一个 theta 乘因子。输入包建议补这四个符号的定义。

GAP-6 [FAILED]：显式硬族 f 没有构造出来。候选 1（K 等份 coverage + 每个 dummy 独立盖每份 beta 比例）在 window 内的最优值是 (tau-1)/K + ((K-tau+1)/K)(1-(1-beta)^{K-tau+1})，形状不对，且取等给 beta=1/(eta(K-tau+1))，比 statement 更强；候选 2（纯 nested dummy）只给 beta>=1/(eta K)，即 L_K(eta) 而非 H。正确来源应是 window 边界 j=tau-1 -> tau 上 f~ 的拼接约束，我只能作为 heuristic 交出。这是本次推导最大的缺口。
空洞性检验附带发现：eta>1（严格）这一限定词在 tau>=2 时被 eta>=(K-1)/(K-tau)>1 完全吞掉（空洞，建议写成 eta >= max{1,(K-1)/(K-tau)}）；adversarial tie breaking 在本定理中我的推导完全没用到（算法是任意确定性算法而非 greedy），建议说明它是否有作用点。
ProbeLottery 这个名字不在四个输入文件中，无法按其定义走查；保守处理是把 K=2 当作定理本身在 K=2 的实例化来算（tau 只能为 1，c=0），并记录该定义缺失。

oracle.notes:
"Run: python3 results/V11/oracle/linear_anysize.py, exit 0, 28 checks, 0 failed, 0 violations, 38.9 s, seed 20260918. Every decision uses fractions.Fraction or sympy; floats appear only inside printed parentheses; no [VERIFIED-LP float] item was needed since no LP solver is involved.

No existing repository file was modified. One caveat worth relaying: results/J7_symbolic.py rewrites its own results/J7_symbolic.json as a side effect of being rerun. The oracle script takes that file's sha256 before and after and restores it from a backup if the bytes change; this run produced byte-identical content (sha256 14307741cd75d8f6...), so only the mtime moved.

Criterion D design choices, chosen conservatively and recorded in the script docstring and the report: (1) the family is re-implemented from the formulas in results/J7/linear_anysize.md rather than imported from results/J7_grid_check.py; (2) structured candidates (forward greedy with adversarial ties, reverse deletion greedy, max of the two) are evaluated by exact count-grid dynamic programming, which is the worst case over placements of O by the symmetry of the family; (3) for the 300 random arbitrary-size strategies the adversary is given full power, namely every one of the C(n,K) placements of O is enumerated, the strategy replayed against that instance, and the MINIMUM ratio taken. That is the correct hardness game (the instance family is parameterised by O), and it avoids the weaker leak-free-O search which is mostly vacuous at n <= 14.

Two quantifier findings for the ledger. First, the must-not-claim on T10d is reproduced exactly: at n < K + t* reverse greedy reads O off the leaking large sets and reaches ratio 1, so a finite-n reading of 'ratio <= W_K' is false and the n -> infinity quantifier cannot be dropped. Second, and new here, the witness of that must-not-claim is itself outside the O(nK) budget at those n (30, 30, 39 queries against nK = 24, 24, 27) and is Theta(n^2) in general, so the finite-n failure constrains the family rather than exhibiting a counterexample inside the algorithm class of the statement. This strengthens rather than weakens the T10d card and is worth one line on it.

The C9 check surfaced a small precision point: identity (7b) 1/m - d = nu Psi(m-1)/(K m B_m) is not an identity in nu treated as a free symbol; its residual numerator is -eta nu + eta + nu, which vanishes exactly at nu = eta/(eta-1). The check was rewritten with nu substituted by its definition and then passes. blind.conclusion_restated: 独立推导给出：在 K=2、eta=3/2 的任意合法实例上，先用 rescaling 把 band 归一为 d <= tilde d <= (3/2)d，再用 tilde f 必须是自洽集合函数这一条（引理 L2，pair 级双侧夹逼）自足地证出 predictive greedy 的基线 f(P_0) >= (3/5)OPT，并给出一个 n=4 的有理实例精确取到 3/5（因此 rho_2(3/2)=3/5 两个方向都不依赖外部文件）。核心新引理 D 给出：pool 中任一元素 v 产生的两个 secondary set 都满足 f >= (3/5 - 2 EPS)OPT，因此彩票的全部 deficit 都是 O(EPS)，期望分解为 E/OPT = beta + (1/1024) sum (gamma_j - beta)。情形分析在三格闭合：eps := beta - 3/5 >= 4.0945e-6 时由 deficit 界直接闭合；eps 更小时刚性链条强迫 o_1,o_2 必在 pool 内（否则 eps > 9.9997e-6，矛盾）；若某轮 extension 取到某个 o_i 则该 secondary set 的 surplus >= 7/30，净余量 2.26e-4 远超目标 2.5e-6。唯一未闭合的一格是 o_1,o_2 在 pool 内但四轮 extension 全被其他元素占据；该格下本文件只能得到 E >= (3/5 - 1.5625e-6)OPT，比目标低 4.1e-6。我按这一格显式构造了 n=7 的候选反例（四个 b 的克隆霸占四轮，8 个 secondary set 全为 3/5），用精确有理 Bellman-Ford 判定 difference-constraint 系统，结论是不可行，阻断它的是一条 triple 级夹逼不等式，这很可能就是补全该格所需的工具。

所有 argmax 返回固定序中的第一个 maximiser；worst-case 陈述允许 adversary 选该序（等价 adversarial tie-breaking）
eta 与 K 的定义域：命题只对 K = 2、eta = 3/2 陈述；4 轮、8 个 secondary、127/128、1/1024、EPS、|S|<=5 全部是为该点校准的常数
结论 E[f(T)] >= (3/5 + 1/400000) OPT，其中 3/5 = rho_2(3/2) 是 predictive greedy 在 adversarial ties 下的精确最坏比
key_steps: L0 scale invariance：算法全部判定对 tilde f 的正数缩放不变（argmax 与两个 pool 判据都是 1 齐次），故可设 d <= tilde d <= (3/2) d
L1 集合级 sandwich：f(S) <= tilde f(S) <= (3/2) f(S)，由沿任意枚举 telescoping
L2 pair-consistency：tilde f({u}) - tilde f({e}) <= (3/2) d_u({e}) - d_e({u})，等价 f({u,e}) >= 2(tilde f({u}) - tilde f({e})) + 3 f({e}) - 2 f({u})；这是把 5/9 提升到 3/5 的唯一新成分
L3/L3' argmax 价值：beta >= (1/3) f({b}) + (2/3) f({b,e}) 对所有 e；同式对 v 与 z_v 成立
命题 4.1 基线：由 (L5) 的 h* >= (1+x)/2 得 beta >= (1+2x)/3，由 (L2) 的 h_i >= 3w_i - 2x 与 w* >= 1/2 得 beta >= 1-x，min-max 在 x = 2/5 处等于 3/5（sympy 复核）
命题 4.2：n=4 有理实例精确取到 beta = 3/5，全子集验 band 与 submodularity，故 rho_2(3/2) = 3/5 双向确认
刚性 R1-R8：beta <= 3/5 + eps 强迫 x、h_i、w_i 分别落在 2/5、7/10、1/2 的 O(eps) 邻域，且 Delta_i = M - tilde f({o_i}) <= (5/2) eps、p - tilde f({b,o_i}) <= 5 eps（常数项恰为 0）
引理 P：eps <= EPS/11 时两个 pool 判据自动满足，故 o_1, o_2 必在 C 内；推论 r = 0 时 eps > 1/110000，命题成立
引理 D（核心）：v 在 C 内时 f({b,v}) >= 3/5 - (2/3) EPS M 且 f({v,z_v}) >= 3/5 - (4/3) EPS M，后者由 max(1/3 + 2phi/3, 1 - phi) >= 3/5 得到（phi = f({v})，最小值在 phi = 2/5 即 b 的克隆处）
彩票算术：127/128 + 8/1024 = 1，E/OPT = beta + (1/1024) sum_{special} (gamma_j - beta)；beta = 3/5 时需要 sum >= 1024/400000 = 0.00256
情形 0：eps >= 13/3175000 = 4.0945e-6 时由 (8.3) 直接闭合（含 beta 很大与 b 在 O* 内的情形）
情形 I 为空：某个 o_i 不在 C 内会强迫 eps > 3/300010 = 9.9997e-6 > 阈值，余量 2.4 倍；同时给出 C 非空
情形 II-a：某轮取到 o_i 时 {o_i, z_{o_i}} 的 surplus >= 7/30 - (14/9) eps，其余 7 个 deficit 合计 <= 7(eps + 2 EPS)，净值/1024 >= 2.26e-4，余量约 90 倍
数值 walk-through：紧实例上 f(P_0) = 3/5 而 E = 3077/5120 = 3/5 + 1/1024，query 11 <= 9n、最大集合 3 <= 5（全部有理精确）
反例攻击：n=7 四克隆封锁构造被精确 Bellman-Ford 判为不可行，最小不可行核是单点预测与 tilde f({b,j_1}) 的组合，机制是 triple 夹逼 11/10 > 21/20
gaps: 情形 II-b 未闭合：o_1 与 o_2 都在 pool C 内、但四轮 extension 全部被其他 pool 元素占据时，缺少产生 surplus 的论证；该格下只得到 E >= (3/5 - 1.5625e-6) OPT，比目标 3/5 + 2.5e-6 低 4.1e-6。已知必要条件是每个挡路者满足 (3/2) d_{v_k}(B) >= d_o(B)，由此 f(B) 沿 11/15、37/45、119/135 递增，但不产生矛盾；显式 n=7 候选反例被判不可行，阻断它的是 triple 级夹逼不等式，推测补全该格需要把 L2 提升到 triple 级别（本文件未做）
